controller_readiness.notes: Highest archive density (4,200 programs incl. Mastercam .mcx-8 + .NC + .MIN). Confirmed ship-ready per ENGINE_DIGEST. WinMAX dialect fully spec'd; needs JM-specific prompt overlay (M30→rapid X0Y0Z0 quirks).
7 lathes share OSP dialect — single engine covers all 7. 11,900 example programs (.MIN with $<INTERNAL>% header per memory). Variant gap: P300SA/MA-H multi-axis untested.
Confirmed in ENGINE_DIGEST as JM Die Wire EDM Master Post Processor. Dialect fully spec'd by Mitsubishi.
No sinker-EDM master post engine found. 3,100 example programs available. Block to revenue: medium — sinker is shrinking market.
Two Haas mills (VF-2, OM-2). PRE-NGC is well-documented dialect, .NC output. Highest market-share opportunity outside JM (~25% US small shops). BUILD NEXT after Hurco.
Only 1 JM machine (Roku-Roku) and 400 examples, BUT Fanuc is 60-70% global market share. External-revenue P0; internal-JM P2. ENGINE_DIGEST shows no FanucMillMasterPostEngine.
No Mazak machines in JM fleet. Defer — no internal training data, MS-PILOT phase only.
European mold/die market. No JM data. Defer.
European auto/aero. No JM data. Defer.

training_pipeline_per_controller.ground_truth_source: Operator-edited shipped programs in JM DIE/ archive — *.NC under PROVEN PRG/ subfolders. CAD-only files (.ipt/.iam/.f3d/.SLDPRT/.x_t/.STEP) are program-equivalent (per memory ref: jm_die_program_save_practice).
training_pipeline_per_controller.validation_method: Roundtrip generated G-code → controller emulator (Hurco WinMAX sim, Okuma OSP-Lathe sim, Haas IPS sim, Fanuc 31i sim) → motion plan compare vs Mastercam .mcx-8 reference. No public emulator for Mitsubishi sinker — defer to MS-PILOT agent 6 dry-run.

revenue_priority_order: Hurco WinMAX v10 (already SHIP-READY — close JM-internal revenue gap first)
Haas PRE-NGC mill (NEW BUILD — biggest external TAM among missing engines, US small-shop market)
Fanuc 31i-B5 mill (NEW BUILD — global market dominance, only 1 JM machine but unlocks 60-70% of external opportunities)
Okuma OSP harden + multi-axis variant coverage (P300SA/MA-H untested)
Mazatrol Smooth / Heidenhain / Siemens (P2 — MS-PILOT phase only)

summary.first_revenue_controller: Hurco WinMAX v10 (already SHIP-READY at JM Die — first revenue is a paid-pilot conversion, not a new build)
summary.verdict: 3 of 9 controllers ship-ready (Hurco mill, Okuma lathe family, Mitsubishi wire EDM). Build Haas PRE-NGC next for external TAM, then Fanuc 31i for market dominance. 18,400 of 24,545 archive programs (75%) are already covered by ship-ready engines.
summary.one_line: Ship-ready: Hurco + Okuma + Mitsubishi-wire (3/9). Attack first: harden Hurco for paid JM pilot, then build Haas PRE-NGC for external revenue.
